transport.mapping: Each source HREF is already https://<same-host>/<key>; HTTPStore uses <same-host> as root and the unchanged original object path as key.
transport.verified: Unauthenticated GeoTIFF header and 256x256 bounded window read succeeded. No AWS credential or metadata lookup.

notebook_reference.mosaic: first valid pixel in source order
notebook_reference.cloud_caveat: Scene-level ranking/filter only; not pixel cloud masking.

review_grid.deviation: Coarsened from notebook 300 m grid to bound output/read volume; all outputs use the same grid and dimensions.

display.rgb_stretch: fixed linear source DN 0..5000 to 0..255, same for every date and pass
display.nodata: RGBA alpha=0 where all RGB values are zero; otherwise alpha=255
display.month_rationale: Visual inspection shows markedly greater Sierra Nevada snow cover in March and a warmer, snow-reduced landscape in May/June. All show substantial image coverage; gaps/clouds are still visible.

pass_grouping.method: Within each month, choose the two datatake groups with the most catalog items passing eo:cloud_cover < 50. Read all qualifying granules in each selected group, first-valid in cloud-sorted source order.
pass_grouping.subset: Six acquisitions total (two per month), out of all monthly datatakes; each includes 58–68 granule items. Separate transparently masked RGB PNGs with WGS84 STAC geometry outlines projected to EPSG:3310.
pass_grouping.overlap_note: Separate acquisitions can be layered transparently. Each datatake itself is composited to one image, so per-pixel tile overlap is not a duplicated stack.

animation_scope: Flat images only per user instruction; rotation/time stacking deferred to Slidev.
